queries_run: Hyatt Hotels market share gaining OR losing 2026 RevPAR vs peers
Hyatt Hotels new entrant OR displace threat Lodging 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列出的競爭來源包含新分銷管道（潛在 AI 平台）、Alibaba、Google、信用卡發行商及 Airbnb/Vrbo 等短租，並指出部分對手規模與會員數大於 Hyatt。
findings.excerpt: We also compete against smaller hotel chains and independent and local owners and operators and face competition from new distribution channels in the travel industry, including potential AI platforms.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素提及產業整併，若競爭對手整併可能使 Hyatt 失去份額或難以吸引業主與加盟商。
findings.excerpt: If we lose market share or are not able to successfully attract third-party owners and franchisees to our brands as a result of this consolidation, our results of operations, cash flow, business, and overall financial condition could be materially adversely affected.

competitive_share_entrants.note: Q2 2026 公司稱 luxury/lifestyle RevPAR index 上半年提升近 3 點、各組合獲取份額（管理層說法，搜尋摘要為轉述，未取得逐字原文）；未找到與 Marriott/Hilton 2026 的同口徑比較，未找到點名的新進入者。

clues.claim: Hyatt 管理層稱 Q2 2026 全組合獲取份額，luxury 與 lifestyle 上半年 RevPAR index 提升近三點。
